title: dotfiles: add @install <url> directive with LLM-built uninstall manifest
description:
Add @install <url> directive to dotfiles for tracked install scripts with LLM-built uninstall manifest.

PURPOSE
Replace ad-hoc !curl|sh / @cache curl|sh lines with a directive that knows what files to remove when the line is deleted from dotfiles.conf. Idempotent through the existing lock+diff loop.

SYNTAX
@install <url>
The URL is the identity. Removing the line from dotfiles.conf triggers cleanup automatically next run.

FLOW (on cly dotfiles -i)
For each @install URL in conf:
1. Fetch script, sha256 it.
2. If lock has entry with matching sha, skip.
3. Else: pipe script to LLM (pkg/llm anthropic Complete) with combined prompt asking for JSON: {manifest:{binaries,dirs,files,shell_rc_changes,fetches_other_scripts,needs_sudo}, security:{risk:low|medium|high, findings:[...]}, final:false, message_to_user:""}.
4. Show manifest+security to user. Interactive review loop: user input feeds back to LLM (claudeContinue with prev result + user msg). Stop words: ok|y|yes|sure|go|ship|approve|lgtm break loop and install. stop|n|no|cancel|abort|quit aborts. Anything else iterates. Loop guard at 10 turns.
5. On approve: run script via existing executeCommand helper. Save manifest+sha to lock.

Removing URL from conf: applyDiff reads manifest, removes binaries+files, rmdir dirs if empty, prints shell_rc_changes as red banner for manual cleanup (matches existing RemovedInstallCommands UX).

CLI
- Reuse existing -i / --install flag (same bucket as ! commands).
- Reuse existing --no-it (skip new analyses; cached unchanged-sha entries still run).
- Reuse existing --dry-run.
- NEW flag: --bypass-ai. Skips LLM analysis entirely. Lock entry has only {url, sha, bypassed:true}. On uninstall: prints red banner saying manual cleanup needed (no manifest to remove).

FILES
- modules/dotfiles/config.go: Install struct {URL, LineNum}, parseInstallLine, dispatch case for @install.
- modules/dotfiles/install.go: NEW. ApplyInstalls, fetchScript (cache at ~/.local/share/cly/dotfiles/install-cache/<sha>.sh), claudeAnalyze using pkg/llm, interactive loop, removeInstallPaths.
- modules/dotfiles/lock.go: Installs []InstallManifest field, RemovedInstalls in LockDiff.
- modules/dotfiles/cmd.go: --bypass-ai flag, wire ApplyInstalls into runSync (in -i/--all block, after !cmds), extend applyDiff for RemovedInstalls.
- Help text update.
- Tests with mock LLM client.

DEPENDS ON: dotfiles: merge jobs-state.json into dotfiles.lock (lock schema must be done first to avoid double migration).

POST: update /Users/yuri/DotFiles/dotfiles.conf — convert these 4 lines:
  line 91:  @once install-pi -- curl -fsSL https://pi.dev/install.sh | sh
  line 114: @cache nsx -- curl -fsSL https://nsx-cli-proxy.nsx.services/main/install.sh | sh
  line 156: !curl -fsSL https://github.com/AikidoSec/safe-chain/releases/latest/download/install-safe-chain.sh | sh
  line 162: @cache hermes -- curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
into:
  @install https://pi.dev/install.sh
  @install https://nsx-cli-proxy.nsx.services/main/install.sh
  @install https://github.com/AikidoSec/safe-chain/releases/latest/download/install-safe-chain.sh
  @install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/main/scripts/install.sh

VERIFY: go test ./modules/dotfiles/...; run cly dotfiles -i on DotFiles, all 4 install scripts analyzed once, manifests saved to lock; remove one URL, next run cleans up its files.

title: dotfiles: merge jobs-state.json into dotfiles.lock
description:
Merge dotfiles jobs-state.json into dotfiles.lock.

Move job execution state from ~/.local/share/cly/dotfiles/jobs-state.json into existing dotfiles.lock next to dotfiles.conf. Single source of truth.

WHAT jobs-state.json DOES
A name->hash(definition) map for @once and @cache jobs. Hash = sha256(run+name+command+every+keepalive+baseDir).
- @once: entry with current hash means skip; differs means re-run.
- @cache: entry with current hash means dont re-run even if command -v would trigger.

PLAN
1. lock.go: change DotfilesLock.Jobs from []string to []JobLockEntry{Name,Hash}. Add custom UnmarshalJSON for backward compat with old []string format. Add migration in loadLock that merges legacy file then deletes it. Change buildLock(cfg) to buildLock(cfg, prev) preserving hashes by name. Update diffLocks.
2. jobs.go: drop paths.StateFile, replace loadOnceState/saveOnceState with versions that read/write the lock. Update callers in ApplyJobs, RemoveJobs, RemoveJobByName, StatusJobs, cleanupStaleManagedJobs.
3. cmd.go: after ApplyJobs reload lock, pass into buildLock(cfg, postJobsLock).
4. Tests: legacy []string unmarshal; JobLockEntry roundtrip; migration deletes legacy file. Update jobs tests referencing StateFile.

VERIFY: go test ./modules/dotfiles/...; run cly dotfiles -j on real DotFiles repo, legacy file gets merged and deleted.
